tree.heading: China
tree.text: The term “China” means the People’s Republic of China.

tree.heading: Humanitarian assistance
tree.text: The term “humanitarian assistance” means assistance to meet humanitarian needs, including needs for food, medicine, medical supplies, clothing, and shelter.

tree.heading: North Korea
tree.text: The term “North Korea” means the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.

tree.heading: North Koreans
tree.text: The term “North Koreans” means persons who are citizens or nationals of North Korea.

tree.heading: South Korea
tree.text: The term “South Korea” means the Republic of Korea.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2008—Par. (1)(A). Pub. L. 110–346 substituted “Foreign Affairs” for “International Relations”.
